transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose my eating has just gotten a bit... turned around lately. Some days I just completely forget about lunch. And then other times, I just find myself standing at the kitchen counter, eating crackers or sweets. Even though... well, nothing really tastes right anyway.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
I suppose so... yes. Mostly in the mornings. I just... wake up with this heavy feeling. Like all the color has already gone out of the day, before I even get dressed. Just... low, I guess.
How long has this low mood and change in your eating pattern been going on—days, weeks, or longer?
Well... longer than a few weeks, I suppose. It feels like... maybe about a year and two months now. Just a... long, colorless stretch.
Over this past year or so, have you also noticed yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things, in a way that's hard to control or turn off?
No... not really. I just feel heavy, mostly. I don't think I worry more than anyone else.
When you skip meals or eat sweets at the counter, is that related to how you feel about your weight or body shape, or does it just happen because you don't feel hungry or interested in food?
No... it's nothing to do with my weight. I just... I'm not very hungry most days. It's just easier to not bother with a real meal, I suppose.
Do you have any current medical illnesses, or are you taking any medications, supplements, or substances that started around the same time as when these mood and eating changes began?
No... nothing like that. I don't take any medications or... supplements. I don't have any other illnesses, really. Just... no.
During this past year or so, has there been any stretch of two months or more where your mood felt basically normal again, or has the low feeling been there almost every day the whole time?

No, not really. It's... it's been pretty much the whole time. Ever since my sister got sick, the sadness and... just not caring about things... it's taken up most of the time. Even when the... the worries about the records weren't as loud, the low feeling was still there. Almost every day.
Over this past year, has the low mood and low interest been severe enough to significantly interfere with your ability to work, care for yourself, or manage daily responsibilities?

Well... yes, I suppose. I don't... I don't teach my craft classes anymore. I just stopped. And... I miss phone calls. Appointments. Things for my family that I used to keep track of. I'm still at home, but... I need more reminders now. I just... put things off. Things that used to be easy.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself, or thoughts that you would be better off dead?

No... I wouldn't do anything to hurt myself. I don't have any sort of plan for that. But... sometimes I do think... maybe if I just didn't wake up tomorrow, it would be easier. Like it might be a relief... for my family. But I wouldn't do anything.
